profiles.name: AniCraft
profiles.limitations: CLI range flags and engine command frame parameters use different bases. The documented live bridge uses a per-run token and requires independent platform and operation checks. Execution inherits the selected environment's OS permissions.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.

profiles.name: EffectCraft
profiles.limitations: Constrained background MCP disables scripts. Verify support for the selected effects and transparent export in the exact release.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.
profiles.verification: Windows 0.24.1 fixture verified editable-masked-lower-third through CLI with a pinned Windows Arial font and a six-frame transparent standalone review span. Other modes and broader render or interruption behavior remain unverified.

profiles.name: FilmCraft
profiles.limitations: Use a single project writer and explicit save. Live control uses a per-session token. The supplied agent guide does not establish confined standalone rendering.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.

profiles.name: SoundCraft
profiles.limitations: Background file roots do not constrain a live attachment. MIDI-controller recording and AAF/OMF session exchange have documented limitations.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.

profiles.name: VectorCraft
profiles.limitations: Automatic mode discovery can attach to a live app. A failed command step can leave earlier file exports and document changes.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.

profiles.name: PhotoCraft
profiles.limitations: Background MCP requires read and write roots. Live control has its own protocol and enabled app setting. Verify export color and bit depth.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.
profiles.verification: Windows 0.23.1 fixture verified the layered-image-card CLI recipe with independently confined execution required. This scope produces standalone review PNGs. Other operations and modes remain documented or unverified.

profiles.name: LightCraft
profiles.limitations: Use an isolated library with one owner and matching app/CLI releases. Local live control has no password. Supported RAW decoding varies.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.
profiles.verification: Windows 0.21.1 fixture verified reusable-photo-treatment through CLI for one RGB JPEG. Its retained catalog and original reopen in a fresh library. The PNG is standalone review. RAW and connected modes remain unverified.

profiles.name: FigCraft
profiles.limitations: Attached file limits are configured on application startup. Inspect the loss of interaction in static exchange and verify import fidelity.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.
profiles.verification: Windows 0.18.1 fixture verified editable-design-variant through CLI with owned batch roots. Independent confinement is required for automatic execution. Static review exposes the compact variant and declares the prototype loss.

profiles.name: TextureCraft
profiles.limitations: Selected CLI and background MCP have their own root flags. Live uses a token. Some bake operations write in place and color inputs use different transfers.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.

profiles.name: DeckCraft
profiles.limitations: Background file roots do not constrain a live connection. Slide indexes begin at zero. A frame export preserves a still representation of slide motion.
profiles.prerequisites: Separately installed matching app and CLI, a permitted selected mode, and task-specific inputs.
profiles.verification: Windows 0.18.1 fixture verified editable-explanation-slide through CLI, including its custom master layout and zero-based fade destination. The selected midpoint PNG is standalone review. Automatic use requires independent confinement.
